meaning:
καυματίζω
(καῦμα),
to burn or scorch up: with accusative before ἐν πυρί, Rev.16:8. Pass., Mat.13:14, Mrk.4:6; before καῦμα μέγα, Rev.16:9.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: When the sun had risen, they were scorched. Because they had no root, they withered away.
When the sun had risen, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.
The fourth poured out his bowl on the sun, and it was given to him to scorch men with fire.
